summary: An excerpt from the sixth book of a fiction series, told in first person. The narrator drives Arthur's sedan westward through the city, pursued by an SUV whose gunner has a grenade launcher. The narrator drives off a high bank into a concrete-lined Los Angeles River channel, and the pursuing SUV crashes headfirst while its gunner fires. The car then flips onto its side and skids down the riverbed as the grenade hits.
one_line: A first-person chase in which the narrator drives Arthur's sedan into a dry concrete Los Angeles River channel to escape a grenade-firing SUV.
key_facts: The narrator is driving Arthur's sedan westward, with pursuers in an SUV still following.
The SUV's gunner is trying to line up a shot with a grenade launcher.
The narrator crosses a bank of railroad tracks, which shakes the sedan almost loose from its frame.
During summer, the Los Angeles River is described as a trickle of water through a wide, high-walled concrete ditch.
The narrator floors the gas pedal and sails off the high bank of the concrete trench.
The sedan lands belly-flop on all four wheels in the bare cement at the bottom of the channel.
The narrator drives northward along the river after landing, with Arthur half-pressed against them in the back.
The SUV flies off the edge, cannot stop in time, and nosedives headfirst into the cement after its driver tries to brake.
The gunner fires the grenade launcher even as the SUV plunges toward the cement.
The narrator sees the grenade's blast pattern as concentric circles of force and realizes no move will be enough.
The narrator jerks the wheel and bounces the car into the concrete channel wall, and the car flips onto its left side.
The car skids down the riverbed on its side, with metal screaming and glass shattering.
The grenade hits as the excerpt ends.

entities.name: Arthur
entities.role: owner of the sedan, who rides behind the narrator and holds on during the chase

entities.name: Los Angeles River
entities.role: concrete-lined river channel where the car chase takes place, a trickle in summer

entities.name: SUV
entities.role: pursuing vehicle whose driver brakes, flips, and plunges into the channel, and whose gunner fires a grenade launcher
